text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —What, Her "Emperor" Majesty isn't in?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you are looking for the President, she 
is away on student council business. I can 
take a message for her instead, if you'd 
like—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, forget it. Wasn't anything important 
anyway. More importantly—something far 
more interesting just came up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You... are you really that guy's 
right-hand man?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I've been curious for a while now. Just 
what kind of person that 'Emperor' keeps 
by her side... that sort of thing."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What are you trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Loosen up a little, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whether through running or anything else, 
I don't care. Let me get a taste of... 
your competitive side.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I am honored by the invitation, but 
unfortunately, I cannot accept any action 
that might be mistaken for an unauthorized 
duel."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As upperclassmen, we are meant to be role 
models for our juniors. We should only 
compete in appropriate venues."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Don't sell me short. It's just a 
game, after all. Nothing to make a big 
fuss over, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Or is this—just a convenient way to run 
away? You're just a lapdog after all. 
Can't do a thing without permission, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—You've quite underestimated me, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I am not so rash as to fall for such 
simple provocation. Furthermore, you seem 
to be mistaken about something—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"In a proper setting, this 'Empress' would 
gladly indulge in what you call 'play' 
with anyone, at any time."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if that is a "great star" that sears 
these very eyes, or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if one is the "Emperor" reigning 
supreme over this world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! So you're not just a puppet following 
orders, huh? ...Fine then, Air Groove. I 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"When the time is right, face me without 
fail. ————Without averting your eyes, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Gladly.
